name: seo-content-blog
cost: Free (MIT). The scripts need no API key and no paid tools
works_with: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and other agents that read skills from disk
short: Specs, audits and benchmarks a blog post against the pages that rank, then writes it to rank on Google and get cited by AI engines.
what: Give it a keyword, topic, draft or post URL. It runs four phases: a spec built on a 12-part article skeleton, an audit of your article, blog hub and author page with bundled Python scripts, a benchmark against the top 3 to 5 search results, and then the build. You get a scorecard, findings, the benchmark, a publish-ready article with metadata and JSON-LD, and an acceptance check.
who: People who run a company blog and want posts that rank and get quoted by AI search. It's one of 20 SEO skills in the pack, so add the keyword research skill if you haven't picked your keyword yet.
needs: A coding agent that supports skills
Python 3.9 or newer for the audit scripts (standard library only)
Your post's URL or draft, and the competitor URLs you want to compare against

steps.title: Add the pack in Claude Code
Ask about a post
steps.text: The right skill picks itself up from your request.

try.label: From the README
try.text: "Our blog has no author box, no table of contents and no covers on the hub. Fix the templates."

watch: The skill treats a timed email capture popup (30 to 40 seconds on the page) as mandatory on every article page. Skip that part if you don't want popups.
If your workspace has an Obsidian vault or a folder of notes, it reads them first and appends what it did to an SEO action log there.
The audit and benchmark scripts fetch your pages and your competitors' pages.
Many thresholds are field rules of thumb from the author's agency audits, and the skill labels which ones are measured.
